characters.summary: Shuri primarily fights as a tactician and advanced technologist, utilizing vibrating sonic gauntlets, cloaking technology, and vibranium-infused combat suits. She later adopts the mantle of the Black Panther, granting her enhanced physical strength, agility, and hand-to-hand combat prowess.
weaknesses: Dependent on specialized equipment and suits for enhanced combat capabilities
limitations: Human physical limits without the Black Panther suit or enhancement

sources.supports: General overview of Shuri's role, technology, and adoption of the Black Panther mantle in the MCU.

feats.claim: Fought against Namor using Wakandan flight vehicles and vibranium weapons.

notableResults.note: Won by dehydrating him and forcing his surrender.

conditional.dependsOn: Black Panther habit suit or heart-shaped herb synthetic equivalent

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes advanced vibranium technology and sonic gauntlets designed by herself.
Employs wrist-mounted sonic blasters and beads with various technical functions.
Created numerous advanced technological devices for Wakanda.
Uses cloaking technology to hide from enemies.

unknowns: Exact long-term combat mastery of the Black Panther mantle compared to T'Challa.

characters.summary: Lady Sif is an elite Asgardian warrior who relies on peerless swordsmanship, traditional Asgardian combat training, and superhuman physical attributes. She engages enemies directly in close-quarters combat with a double-bladed sword or sword and shield.

mechanisms: Asgardian physiology providing high durability and healing

weaknesses: Vulnerable to powerful cosmic or magical forces capable of overcoming Asgardian durability

sources.supports: General character background of Lady Sif across Thor films and television appearances.

feats.claim: Fought alongside Thor against Frost Giants on Jotunheim.

notableResults.note: Defeated controlled opponents in hand-to-hand combat.

campaignTags.claim: Not applicable; travels via Bifrost or horses.

unknowns: Exact status of her combat abilities after surviving the Blip.

characters.summary: Smart Hulk combines Bruce Banner's intellect with the Hulk's massive physical body. He relies primarily on overwhelming physical strength, smashing attacks, and sheer durability, largely abandoning rage-driven frenzy in favor of calculated physical dominance.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to injuries affecting his arms (e.g., Infinity Gauntlet gamma radiation damage)
limitations: Right arm permanently damaged after using the Infinity Gauntlet
Less ferocious than the pure rage Hulk

sources.supports: Details on Bruce Banner merging his mind and the Hulk's body to become Smart Hulk.

feats.claim: Wielded the Nano Gauntlet containing all six Infinity Stones.

notableResults.note: Fought as part of the combined hero forces.

campaignTags.claim: Possesses a massive humanoid body well over eight feet tall.
Displays rapid healing capabilities typical of Hulk physiology.

unknowns: Whether Smart Hulk can still access peak rage-fueled strength spikes of savage Hulk.

characters.summary: Spider-Man fights using enhanced proportional spider strength, acrobatic agility, wall-crawling, and web-shooters to immobilize or disorient opponents. He combines improvisational combat with advanced Stark-engineered tech suits.
weaknesses: Relies heavily on his web-shooters and suit technology when facing heavily armed foes
limitations: Web-fluid supply is finite and can run out

sources.supports: Overview of Spider-Man's abilities, gadgets, and feats in the MCU.

feats.claim: Caught a punch from Cull Obsidian and held up a jet bridge.
feats.citation: Captain America: Civil War / Avengers: Infinity War

notableResults.note: Fought to a standstill before being outsmarted.

conditional.ability: Instant-kill mode and advanced nanotech weapons

campaignTags.claim: Uses advanced web-shooters with multiple web-fluid settings.
Utilizes the Iron Spider suit equipped with mechanical arms and nanotech.

unknowns: Exact limits of Spider-Sense reaction speed under complex multi-target ambushes.

characters.summary: Operating under the influence of the alien symbiote, Spider-Man exhibits amplified physical strength, aggressive combat tactics, autonomous defensive webbing, and a ruthless disposition.
weaknesses: Extreme vulnerability to high-frequency sonic vibrations and intense fire/heat
characters.formDifferences: Replaces standard fabric or tech suits with a living alien symbiote that boosts aggression, physical output, and grants organic webbing.

sources.supports: General properties, strengths, and weaknesses of symbiote-enhanced hosts.

unknowns: Exact MCU-specific canonical combat record for this specific form separate from general adaptations.

characters.summary: Sprite is an Eternal who specializes in cosmic illusion casting, deception, and psychological misdirection. While physically resembling a child, she possesses millennia of combat awareness but avoids direct brawling in favor of tactical illusions.
weaknesses: Lacks heavy physical striking power; vulnerable if illusions are bypassed or seen through
limitations: Physical strength is limited to baseline Eternal child form

sources.supports: Details on Sprite's Eternal abilities, illusion creation, and dagger usage.

feats.claim: Created massive illusions to deceive Sersi and other Eternals.

notableResults.note: Assisted in the final confrontation using illusions.

unknowns: Full offensive potential without reliance on illusions.

characters.summary: Star-Lord fights as a space-faring mercenary utilizing dual element blasters, jet boots for flight, gravity mines, and various makeshift gadgets. He relies on improvisation, agility, and tactical teamwork.
weaknesses: Prone to emotional provocation; fragile physiology compared to super-powered beings
limitations: Jet boots and helmet require technological power sources

sources.supports: Overview of Star-Lord's gear, jet boots, element blasters, and combat style.

feats.claim: Managed celestial energy while holding an Infinity Stone.

notableResults.note: Lost control of his emotions on Titan, ruining the team's plan.

campaignTags.claim: Utilizes jet boots for aerial mobility and flight.
Employs gravity mines, taser spheres, and multipurpose blasters.
Expert pilot of the Milano and Benatar starships.

unknowns: Extent of half-celestial powers after Ego's death.

characters.summary: Stick is a blind martial arts master and mentor to Daredevil and Elektra. He fights using exceptional sensory perception, traditional melee weapons, and mastery of the Chaste martial arts style.
weaknesses: Vulnerable to sensory overload or attacks that exploit blindness if senses are masked
limitations: Human physical conditioning subject to aging

sources.supports: Background on Stick as a martial arts master in Marvel television series.

feats.claim: Fought multiple Hand assassins simultaneously in close combat.

notableResults.note: Killed by Elektra during the Hand conflict.

unknowns: Full extent of his mystical chi abilities compared to comic counterpart.

characters.summary: Taserface is a Ravager mutineer who relies on standard brute force, heavy firearms, and bladed melee weapons. He engages in aggressive, unrefined combat.
weaknesses: Prone to overconfidence and poor tactical planning
mobility: Standard foot movement and spacecraft passenger

sources.supports: Details on Taserface's role, weapons, and mutiny among the Ravagers.

feats.claim: Led a mutiny against Yondu Udonta, taking control of the Ravager faction.

notableResults.note: Outsmarted and defeated via explosive traps.

campaignTags.claim: Uses standard Ravager energy weaponry and ship tech.

unknowns: True origin of his nickname and why he chose it.

characters.summary: Taskmaster possesses photographic reflexes, allowing her to instantly mimic the fighting styles, weapon proficiencies, and physical maneuvers of any opponent she observes. She fights using a combination of acquired martial arts, a shield, sword, bow, and claw gauntlets.
weaknesses: Relying on visual observation means unfamiliar fighting styles or unpredictable movements can disrupt her mimicry
limitations: Human physical limits enhanced only by Red Room conditioning

sources.supports: Overview of Taskmaster's photographic reflexes and weapons used in Black Widow.

feats.claim: Replicated the fighting styles of Black Widow, Hawkeye, Black Panther, and Captain America.

notableResults.note: Defeated when Natasha broke her conditioning with a Red Room gas payload.

campaignTags.claim: Uses versatile combat gear mimicking various Avengers' weapons.

unknowns: Full capacity of tactical adaptation after breaking free from Dreykov's control.
